project.name: 听域 ZoneTune 应用设计
project.styleDefinitionBrief: 音乐播放器 App，冷静工作室美学，steel-teal 主色调，Fraunces/Figtree/Noto Serif SC 字体系统，柔和圆角，克制的表面层次。
project.designRead: Music player app / Chinese indie music lovers / calm studio restraint / low-medium density / avoid generic music app neon glow

colorSystem.primaryColorRole: steel-teal #2F6F7E for primary CTA, active nav, workstation card

styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: Fraunces + Noto Serif SC for display, Figtree for body
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: border-first cards, surface layering, no heavy shadows
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: border-first surfaces, shadow alpha <= 0.05 for static
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: material icons outlined style, album cover rounded corners

sharedProjectShellContract.navigationShell: bottom tab bar with 3 tabs: 发现/搜索/我的, mini player bar above nav
sharedProjectShellContract.typographySystem: Fraunces/Noto Serif SC display, Figtree body
sharedProjectShellContract.ctaStyle: rounded pill buttons, steel-teal filled primary
sharedProjectShellContract.alignmentRules: left-aligned text blocks, centered tab bar, generous padding

designSource.designDecisionSummary: Steel Resonance palette from ZoneTune source code: cool paper background, graphite ink text, steel-teal accent, Fraunces/Figtree/Noto Serif SC fonts, rounded corner shape system, border-first surface treatment.

pages.title: 发现页
pages.businessScenario: Main discovery feed with workstation card, shortcut row, continue listening, and hot waterfall
pages.visualNorthStar: Centered studio specimen: workstation hero card with steel-teal gradient, compact waterfall grid, measured spacing

pages.title: 正在播放
pages.businessScenario: Full-screen now playing with album art, playback controls, progress slider, play mode
pages.visualNorthStar: Expansive album art centered on atmospheric field, minimal controls, steel-teal accent only on play button

pages.title: 搜索页
pages.businessScenario: Search input with history chips and results list
pages.visualNorthStar: Clean search field at top, history chips below, track list with cover thumbnails

pages.title: 我的
pages.businessScenario: Account card, shortcuts, recent plays, favorites list
pages.visualNorthStar: Account card hero with avatar, clean section dividers, track list rows
